subject: About utilities to convert Amber input files for MD into the Tinker, NAMD, Genesis, or Desmond input files

messages.author: Vlad
messages.body:
Dear Amber Gurus,
Do you know of any utilities to convert Amber input files for MD into
the Tinker, NAMD, Genesis, or Desmond input files?
It looks as these programs have better parallel scaling for many
hundreds of CPUs...
Thanks,
Vlad
--

messages.author: Elvis Martis
messages.body:
Hi
Here is at least one way to convert AMBER trajectories to Desmond cms
http://ambermd.org/desmond.html
Best Regards
